alt: 衣著整齊的男子已有滿車物資，卻仍搶走避雨者的毯子與食物，旁人驚訝地伸手阻止。
scene_prompt: 現代正常人類外貌、衣著端正的成年男子，在簡陋避雨棚前冷酷奪走受困旅人唯一的毯子與食物袋，自己已有堆滿物資的推車仍不肯讓出；受害成人與孩子抱在一起發抖難過，旁人震驚並伸手制止。反差是外表像普通人而行為殘酷惡毒，不能只畫動物頭、獸身、獠牙或怪獸，也不要僅一個小玩笑。無血腥、打人、武器、身體傷害、歧視身份。
style_prompt: Create ONE original children's picture-book illustration for a Traditional Chinese idiom learning website. Landscape 3:2. Modern everyday setting when appropriate, original people in present-day casual clothes. NO text, letters, numerals, captions, titles, logos, watermarks or identifiable existing characters. Clear visual storytelling for elementary-school readers and mobile size. Hand-drawn delicate graphite pencil contours, soft translucent watercolor washes layered with colored-pencil grain and hatching on warm ivory textured paper. Restrained natural grass greens, pale sky blues, warm earthy browns, generous ivory breathing room. No flat digital color blocks, glossy rendering, 3D or imitation of a named artist. Every person has exactly two anatomically coherent arms and natural hands; do not add a third arm when someone points while holding an object. Keep before/after vignettes visually separated, recurring people identifiable by consistent clothes, and wordless speech/thought bubble tails attached to the correct person. Scene:
